purpose: Project underground chambers from park POI regions and route zones from small roads and walking paths.

source.regions: stable park POI + associated original park polygon; bounded POI influence only if no reliable polygon
exclude: parking aisles pruned by current pipeline
water crossings and bridge spans without an explicit underground connector

identity.inputs: generated surface metadata at every depth; independent of player position, tile clipping, restoration and dug walls

nexusVariants.name: Underground Spring Cave
nexusVariants.layout: loop around a spring, mushroom edges, optional mineral alcove
nexusVariants.interaction: proposed watering-can refill adapter; reachable bank; no free healing
nexusVariants.reward: reuse a surviving mirrored POI cache; no extra daily chest

nexusVariants.name: Goblin Warrens
nexusVariants.layout: connected stone-walled rooms around a central store; two-cell doors and open main approaches
nexusVariants.interaction: clear sentry, break stores, mine optional collapse
nexusVariants.reward: reuse a surviving mirrored POI cache; barrels replace allocated finite containers

routeVariants.mechanic: sparse harvestable mushroom edges; uninterrupted central lane
bank beside small impassable pools; always retain a dry connection
mineable side alcoves; rare existing supply cache allocation
stone-walled passage, open doorways to sentry and storage alcoves, optional traps with bypasses

proposedTuning.weights: relative before existing soft affinity adjustments; proposal only
proposedTuning.routeRewards: budget per canonical connected route component and depth, never per tile or segment

terrainContract: Project eligible route lines before generic cave dressing. Small-road corridors explicitly carve CAVE_WALL; walking paths already yield CAVE_FLOOR.
No carve through building or water provenance, medium/large road bands, saved structures, or excluded access regions.
Keep a per-depth geology base separate from the projected design overlay, so a shallow corridor does not silently propagate deeper.
Plan original staircase identities from the existing unmodified geology. Preserve actual stairs and reserve clear approaches before adding zone pieces.
Connect a park chamber only to a route that intersects or reaches it through eligible park floor; no straight-line connection across unrelated obstructions.
Do not close existing reachable routes to force a warren maze. Use wall-adjacent rooms and removable obstacles outside the through lane.
At seams use canonical source geometry and world positions; ambiguous or missing geometry keeps ordinary cave generation.
economy: Anchor regions from surface geography, even when POI mirrors are pruned at an earlier depth.
Style at most one surviving mirror as the cache; retain its current chest-tier and depth rules in the first slice.
If no mirror survives, keep a spring or encounter landmark without minting a replacement chest.
Zone finds and containers replace allocated ordinary cave seats; measure total loot before tuning additional rewards.
Path intersections confer connectivity, not extra rewards or extra daily ledgers.
Use existing picked/opened/caught/treasure persistence with stable depth-qualified IDs.

implementation.deliverable: Preview projection of parks and small-road/path geometry over existing cave terrain, including seams and blocked connections.
Add depth-scoped zone and route masks; explicit small-road carve; preserve staircase topology and inherited geology.
Place spring and warren layouts before generic rocks, mushrooms, extras and enemy seats; reserve whole clear lanes.
Override local EnemyHabitats.caveAt context with zone context, intersect enemy roster depth rules and reallocate existing encounter budget.
Register only selected art frames, interactions and footprints; audit economy, reachability, persistence and frame-time cost.

checks: Same source region and route across adjacent tiles and reversed load order.
Reload, player digging and surface restoration never reroll generated anchors.
Every active nexus and stair has a walkable approach; all required through routes remain connected.
No carves under excluded roads, buildings or water; no surface terrain change.
No duplicate finds, guards or caches at seams and junctions.
Depth 1 never uses deeper goblin roster entries; no empty habitat silently produces illegal enemies.
Compare capped chest totals and expected resource value against baseline cave seeds.
Check inspected art at game scale, transparent margins, frame rectangles, readable interactions and shared footprint reservation.

art.name: Spring source
art.mechanic: Refill a watering can through a proposed spring interaction. Keep the centre impassable and its bank reachable; no healing or fishing in the first slice.

art.name: Mushroom beds
art.mechanic: Harvest existing cave mushrooms along chamber edges. Replace ordinary mushroom seats within the zone.

art.name: Crystal seam
art.mechanic: A finite mineable find using existing ore requirements and drops; one existing rock seat changes appearance. Colour must match its actual yield.

art.name: Collapsed side room
art.mechanic: Mine rubble to open an optional cache alcove. The main passage stays open; use existing mineral-rock removal.

art.name: Warren stores
art.mechanic: Breakable supply cache. Spend the zone’s existing finite container budget; no repeated cache on every path segment.

art.name: Mineable stalagmite
art.mechanic: A mineable ordinary-rock appearance beside the route. Bare floor remains the readable walking lane.

art.name: Warren choke point
art.mechanic: Reuse the trap system in an optional flank with a visible alternate route. Review animation frames and timing before importing.

art.name: Timbered entrance
art.mechanic: Possible staircase appearance. Sheet contains multiple entrances; choose and register one frame rather than placing the sheet.

art.name: Bone pile
art.mechanic: Hold until it has an explicit interaction and yield. It should not become decorative standing clutter.

art.name: Zoria underworld sheet
art.mechanic: Inspected: strongly limited palette and uncertain compatibility. Hold as reference; the accompanying readme describes unfinished underworld work.

openDecisions: First slice proposes water refill only; healing springs would need a separate economy decision.
Depths 4+ remain ordinary caves until explicit deeper variants and legal enemy pools are designed.
Point-only POI coverage needs a reviewed influence radius before activation.

previewRows.name: Underground Spring Cave
previewRows.atmosphere: A loop around a cool spring, mushroom beds at the wall and a short mineral alcove.
previewRows.poi: One reachable spring bank; at most one surviving mirrored POI cache.
previewRows.connection: Open loop; two approaches when geography permits.
previewRows.monsters: D1: cave slime / bat; D2: cave slime / bat / spider; D3: spider / purple slime.
previewRows.source: Park POI region; wet and wooded affinities.

previewRows.name: Goblin Warrens
previewRows.atmosphere: Connected stone walls divide the warren into small rooms around a guarded store. Two-cell doorways keep the main routes open; rubble blocks only optional alcoves.
previewRows.poi: One store chamber around an existing mirrored POI cache.
previewRows.connection: Connected 6 × 6 stone-room grid; two-cell doorways on each side, with a clear nexus approach.
previewRows.monsters: D1: club goblin; D2: club / spear goblin; D3: spear / archer goblin.
previewRows.source: Park POI region; worked and built-edge affinities.

walls.mechanic: Proposed blocking cave structure; no item drop or extra reward. Reuse the stone wall art, with topology chosen from surviving cardinal neighbors.
walls.placement: Preserve open doorways, stairs and the through route; walls are structural and counted separately from harvestable objects.

previewRows.name: Root Passage
previewRows.atmosphere: Harvestable mushroom pockets frame an uninterrupted walking lane.
previewRows.poi: No extra nexus or cache per route segment.
previewRows.connection: One-cell clear centre; follows actual path bends and junctions.
previewRows.monsters: Depth-legal spring family; reallocate existing ambient seats.
previewRows.source: Walking path beneath wooded parks or approaching a spring.

previewRows.name: Seep Passage
previewRows.atmosphere: Small pools sit beside a continuous dry bank. Refilling is proposed; water never seals the through route.
previewRows.poi: Reachable water banks; no extra daily reward.
previewRows.connection: Two-cell dry middle where geometry permits.
previewRows.monsters: Depth-legal spring family; keep water-bank approaches clear.
previewRows.source: Walking path adjoining a spring or wet park region.

previewRows.name: Miners’ Way
previewRows.atmosphere: A broad tunnel with mineable side alcoves. Its larger width distinguishes the small-road route from a footpath.
previewRows.poi: Finite finds replace existing cave-rock allocations.
previewRows.connection: Two-cell clear lane; explicit carve beneath eligible small roads.
previewRows.monsters: Existing cave family; no extra guard budget from route length.
previewRows.source: Public minor / street / service lines; never unknown road fallback.

previewRows.name: Warren Run
previewRows.atmosphere: Stone walls line a two-cell passage. Open doorways lead into narrow sentry and storage alcoves; supplies and optional traps stay out of the through lane.
previewRows.poi: Containers spend the parent region / route finite budget.
previewRows.connection: Two-cell central passage with stone-walled side alcoves and two-cell door openings.
previewRows.monsters: D1: club; D2: club / spear; D3: spear / archer goblins.
previewRows.source: Small road or walking path entering Goblin Warrens.

walls.mechanic: Proposed blocking cave structure; no item drop or extra reward. Reuse the stone wall art, with topology chosen from surviving cardinal neighbors.
walls.placement: Preserve open doorways, stairs and the through route; walls are structural and counted separately from harvestable objects.

previewNote: Authored representative patterns, not generated live cave placement. Nominal motif occupancy is calculated from listed slots; POI, encounter and optional trap seats are separate. Existing geology clips all patterns.
